PR: Handle deletes in `WatchOperation` (and add more E2Es) [closed]
### Description of your changes

I started adding more E2E tests, and one of them caught that we weren't creating an Operation when a resource watched by a WatchOperation was deleted. The fix is a bit of a hack due to a controller-runtime limitation, but I feel comfortable with it per the comment I've added.
